title: Computer Applications
description: Computer Applications (Java, Group III) for ICSE Examination Year 2027: classes, methods, constructors, arrays and string handling with programming practice.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Year 2027 Computer Applications (86) syllabus (February 2025 document, reproduced); corroborated by the Oswal and Jagran Josh 2026-27 listings.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Eight prescribed units, unit 1 being revision of the Class IX syllabus. A 100-mark written paper of 2 hours with 100 marks of internal assessment (about 20 laboratory assignments) on a 50/50 basis. No 2028 document was independently readable, so only 2027 is recorded.

sections.title: Computer Applications
sections.description: Java programming from objects and classes to arrays and strings.

chapters.title: Programming Fundamentals: Revision
chapters.blurb: Objects and classes, data types, Java operators, input, library maths methods, conditionals and loops as the Class X starting point.

chapters.title: Class as the Basis of all Computation
chapters.blurb: State and behaviour, member variables and methods, primitive and composite types, creating and using objects.

chapters.title: User-defined Methods
chapters.blurb: Defining and invoking methods, static and instance methods, parameters, return values, call by value and method overloading.

chapters.title: Constructors
chapters.blurb: Default and parameterised constructors, constructor overloading and the difference between a constructor and a method.

chapters.title: Library Classes
chapters.blurb: Wrapper classes, the prescribed numeric and character methods, autoboxing and unboxing.

chapters.title: Encapsulation
chapters.blurb: Access specifiers, visibility and scope, and the difference between class, instance, argument and local variables.

chapters.title: Arrays
chapters.blurb: Single and two-dimensional arrays, row, column and diagonal operations, and the storage patterns they create.

chapters.title: Sorting and Searching
chapters.blurb: Selection sort, bubble sort, linear search and binary search written in Java and traced step by step.

chapters.title: String Handling
chapters.blurb: String methods, string arrays, extracting and modifying characters, and sorting and searching strings.
